one_line: An agent-native data portal for discovering, querying, validating, and staging data products with human review.
what_it_does: Combines catalog, schema, bounded data previews, browser-local SQL, quality checks, lineage, runs, costs, and publication staging in one shared workspace.
leverage_rationale: Structured discovery, SQL, lineage, quality, and staging tools make agent operation substantially more reliable than UI-driving a complex data portal, while humans retain approval of publication.
leverage_evidence: Pitch and about text describe explicit WebMCP tools for datasets, lineage, SQL, quality checks, runs, and staging.
Frame sheets show catalog, detail, query/result, and run-oriented portal states with visible human-facing feedback.
execution_rationale: The packet shows a coherent, broad data-development workflow with catalog, results, status, and review surfaces; exact end-to-end tool traces are not legible.
execution_evidence: Three video frame sheets show multiple portal states and result/status panels.
Description specifies DuckDB-Wasm, generated catalog data, visual results, lineage, quality failures, and mocked staging runs.
impact_rationale: Data developers have a clear, costly coordination problem across catalogs, SQL, lineage, quality, and pipeline runs, and this product addresses it directly.
impact_evidence: Description identifies the fragmented data-development workflow and the intended developer audience.
Frames show a substantial data portal rather than a single isolated action.
creativity_rationale: The shared agent-native data workspace and explicit human approval boundary are a fresh, ambitious synthesis for data engineering.
creativity_evidence: Agent and developer share live data-product state, results, lineage, and runs.
Browser-local DuckDB plus staged publication and quality checks pursue the concept deeply.
usability_note: Dense but purpose-built portal; likely usable for technical data users, with complexity inherent to the scope.
red_flags: Protocol-level tool calls are not readable in the contact sheets; staging is described as mocked.
standouts: Broad structured surface spanning discovery through publication preparation.
advance_reason: High-leverage, coherent agent-native workflow with substantial visible product scope.

one_line: A shared canvas for building, branching, and comparing alternate futures with an AI collaborator.
what_it_does: Lets humans and agents create universes, add and edit events, explore what-ifs, duplicate or collapse branches, and compare outcomes on one live canvas.
leverage_rationale: Shared structured branch/event state and dedicated mutation and comparison tools make agent collaboration materially more precise than browser automation.
leverage_evidence: About text names eleven tools covering universe state, branches, events, what-ifs, duplication, collapse, and comparison.
Frames show populated branching canvases and an agent-joins-canvas state.
execution_rationale: The demonstrated canvas states form a coherent flow from scenario creation to multiple branches and agent collaboration; exact calls are not directly legible.
execution_evidence: Frame sheets show initial, populated, and expanded branching-canvas states.
Description gives a concrete Lisbon/Montréal scenario ending in a third seasonal option.
impact_rationale: Decision-makers and creative planners can gain value from making assumptions and reversible alternatives explicit, though the audience is narrower than generic productivity tools.
impact_evidence: Description identifies personal and broader future-planning use cases.
Frames visibly show a usable scenario canvas with alternative paths.
creativity_rationale: The product treats futures as a living, collaborative branching artifact rather than an AI answer; the interaction model is distinctive and memorable.
creativity_evidence: Shared human-agent canvas and reversible alternative-future modeling.
Concrete third-option discovery is pursued through connected events and branches.
usability_note: Clear visual metaphor and direct manipulation support exploration, though populated canvases may become complex.
red_flags: Exact WebMCP payloads are not visible; claims of agent action rely on product presentation and description.
standouts: Strong fit between structured state and agent collaboration.
advance_reason: Highly creative and well-aligned use of WebMCP for shared, inspectable state.

one_line: A research observatory for tracing commercial infrastructure behind online information operations.
what_it_does: Helps researchers and agents search, organize, inspect cited evidence, map relationships, and retain promising investigative leads in a notebook and atlas.
leverage_rationale: Research involves many heterogeneous sources and relationship traversals; structured page-scoped tools can preserve provenance and state more reliably than UI automation.
leverage_evidence: Description explicitly frames researcher and agent working on the same inspectable terrain.
Frames show evidence, result, and map/relationship views across an investigation workflow.
execution_rationale: The packet shows an ambitious, coherent observatory concept with forms, evidence views, maps, and lead retention, but the small frames do not prove every path end-to-end.
execution_evidence: Three contact sheets show sequential research-oriented application states, relationship visualizations, and evidence panels.
Description names research brief, notebook, Atlas Relay map, and evidence workflow.
impact_rationale: Investigators and journalists have a real need to connect scattered infrastructure evidence without confusing suggestive patterns for conclusions; the product directly supports that work.
impact_evidence: Description grounds the use case in platform, registry, hosting, advertising, payment, and ecommerce traces.
Visible frames show evidence handling and relationship-oriented investigation surfaces.
creativity_rationale: Applying WebMCP to expose the hidden commercial substrate of information operations is unusually original and pursued as both observatory and research-method experiment.
creativity_evidence: Concept connects ecommerce infrastructure, evidence provenance, and agent-assisted investigation.
The thesis-oriented framing and Atlas Relay/map workflow go beyond a generic dashboard.
usability_note: Potentially powerful but information-dense; novice usability is not established by the packet.
red_flags: Many frame labels and details are too small to verify exact operations or provenance behavior.
standouts: Strong attention to uncertainty, evidence, and human interpretation.
advance_reason: Exceptional impact and creativity with a credible, if densely evidenced, research workflow.

one_line: A video editor that learns semantic edits by example, proposes generalized plans, and waits for approval.
what_it_does: Captures a human edit on a shared timeline, exposes semantic project state to an agent, proposes analogous operations, and applies them only after review.
leverage_rationale: WebMCP exposes live semantic timeline state and actions, enabling example-based generalization and approval rather than brittle clicks or opaque external instructions.
leverage_evidence: Description specifies get_project_state, semantic before/after capture, generalized Edit Plans, and human approval.
Frames visibly show editor, proposed-action, approval, preview, and result states.
execution_rationale: The central teach-propose-approve-preview loop is clearly articulated and visually represented, with a compact scope that appears coherent.
execution_evidence: Three frame sheets show timeline/editor states, proposal-like panels, approval controls, and preview/result states.
Description gives a concrete three-still example with duration, track, and fade.
impact_rationale: Editors frequently repeat semantic treatments across assets; example-based automation with a review gate addresses a real creative workflow problem.
impact_evidence: Description explains why editing intent is semantic and why separate agents lose shared state.
Frames show a working browser editor and reviewable plan flow.
creativity_rationale: Teaching an editor by demonstration and generalizing the semantic treatment is a novel interaction model, pursued with explicit approval and shared state.
creativity_evidence: Teach by Example converts a human edit into a structured reusable operation.
Approval boundary and live timeline make the concept memorable and coherent.
usability_note: Review-first design is approachable for editors; the compact scope limits visible complexity.
red_flags: Some preview frames look like test media/loading states rather than polished final footage.
standouts: Best-in-class shared semantic state and approval model.
advance_reason: Transformative WebMCP leverage combined with a clearly demonstrated, original workflow.

one_line: A guided HIPAA exposure assessment that gives practices a readiness score and human-controlled remediation path.
what_it_does: Asks bounded questions about AI use, explains risks and statutes, and provides a gated remediation roadmap without allowing the agent to make the consequential decision.
leverage_rationale: Bounded, schema-constrained tools and explicit human handoffs make an agent-led assessment safer and more reliable than scraping a compliance questionnaire.
leverage_evidence: Description lists nine tools with bounded enums, no free-text assessment inputs, and decision handoffs.
Frames show repeated assessment/form states and apparent result screens.
execution_rationale: The scope is coherent and safety-conscious, but the contact sheets do not make the complete score-to-roadmap flow or exact tool behavior legible.
execution_evidence: Three sheets show multiple form and result-like states.
Description specifies readiness score, three exposures, thirty-control library, and email-gated roadmap.
impact_rationale: Small practices already using AI face real HIPAA and consent risks; a fast, actionable assessment has credible high value for that audience.
impact_evidence: Description names ambient scribes, consumer AI, BAAs, consent, and risk-analysis gaps.
Product promise is a three-minute assessment with statute-linked exposures.
creativity_rationale: The combination of agent-led compliance questioning, spoken-safe outputs, bounded inputs, and a deliberate human-only decision boundary is an original safety-oriented interaction.
creativity_evidence: Gate prevents the agent from taking the key decision and rejects supplied email arguments.
Legal disclaimer travels in tool returns and tools are designed for spoken agent flows.
usability_note: Short bounded questionnaire and clear handoffs suggest strong usability, though the packet does not prove the full path.
red_flags: No public repository and the frames do not visibly expose WebMCP calls; compliance accuracy itself is not independently assessable.
advance_reason: High-impact safety workflow with strong product framing, despite thinner observable execution evidence.

one_line: An AI commerce platform where agents search across independent African sellers and add products to the correct cart.
what_it_does: Supports AI-assisted store creation and exposes structured multi-store product, stock, variant, merchant, and cart data for agent shopping.
leverage_rationale: Cross-store structured catalog and cart operations avoid fragile scraping and preserve merchant, inventory, currency, and variant semantics.
leverage_evidence: Pitch and description explicitly contrast WebMCP with scraping and name products, stores, stock, variants, and carts.
Frames show AI store-generation, storefront, and catalog surfaces.
execution_rationale: The packet supports a substantial store-building and storefront product, but does not visibly prove the full agent search-to-cart path.
execution_evidence: Three frame sheets show implementation, AI store creation, and customer-facing storefront states.
Description specifies multi-merchant stores and Paystack checkout context.
impact_rationale: Reducing technical barriers for African SMEs to launch stores and making their catalogs agent-discoverable addresses a real commerce access problem.
impact_evidence: Description identifies small sellers relying on social media and lacking resources for conventional ecommerce.
Frames show live-store and product-presentation surfaces.
creativity_rationale: The many-sellers-one-marketplace model paired with agent-native catalog and cart semantics is a fresh commerce architecture for the target context.
creativity_evidence: Agent can search across independent stores while routing to the correct merchant cart.
AI-generated storefront creation and WebMCP shopping are combined in one concept.
usability_note: Storefronts appear approachable; multi-merchant routing and checkout details are not fully demonstrated.
red_flags: Visual packet emphasizes development/storefront screens more than an observable WebMCP search-and-cart run.
advance_reason: Meaningful commerce impact and strong leverage concept, with some execution uncertainty.

one_line: An AI piano teacher that demonstrates exercises, listens to playing, gives feedback, and saves lessons.
what_it_does: Uses a piano UI plus MIDI or keyboard input to show notes, play demonstrations, assess performance, and retain personalized lessons.
leverage_rationale: WebMCP connects agent teaching decisions to live musical state and saved lessons, while the page handles timing and analysis; this is more than generic UI driving.
leverage_evidence: Description names show_notes, play_notes, listen, and save_lesson tools.
Frames show piano keyboard, highlighted-note guidance, and changing lesson states.
execution_rationale: The visible keyboard/lesson workflow is coherent and the description reports a complete real-MIDI interaction, but audio-dependent quality cannot be assessed.
execution_evidence: Three frame sheets show multiple piano lesson and note-highlight states.
Description reports teach, demonstrate, listen, feedback, and save-personalized-lesson flow.
impact_rationale: Beginners with unused keyboards have a clear need for affordable, anytime practice guidance and feedback.
impact_evidence: Description identifies beginner practice uncertainty and supports MIDI, computer keyboard, and on-screen keys.
Frames show a dedicated lesson interface.
creativity_rationale: A page-native agent piano teacher that shares live musical state and creates lessons is a compelling, well-pursued interaction beyond a chatbot tutor.
creativity_evidence: Agent decides what to teach while the page handles musical timing and analysis.
Local lesson library and physical MIDI relay address real interaction constraints.
usability_note: Multiple input modes help accessibility; hardware setup may add friction.
red_flags: Audio quality, musicality, timing feel, and listening accuracy are not assessable from silent contact sheets per directive.
Exact agent invocation is not legible.
advance_reason: High-value educational workflow with credible tool depth; audio claims are appropriately not scored.

one_line: A map workspace that combines commute, amenity, school, and healthcare constraints into livable-area recommendations.
what_it_does: Lets agents search places, add travel limits, combine conditions, rank areas, explain trade-offs, update or undo plans, and create shareable results.
leverage_rationale: Combining heterogeneous spatial constraints and preserving reversible shared map state is materially more precise than general agents clicking map controls.
leverage_evidence: Description names structured search, travel limits, combination, ranking, explanation, undo, sharing, and draw-boundary tools.
Frames show map plus controls across iterative result states.
execution_rationale: The map UI and repeated configured/result states support a coherent workflow, though exact tool traces and data provenance are not readable.
execution_evidence: Three frame sheets show interactive map, sidebar controls, markers/regions, and changed result states.
Description specifies real OSM/street/place data, H3 indexing, workers, and reversible action history.
impact_rationale: Choosing where to live requires balancing multiple spatial needs; this directly addresses a common, high-stakes planning task.
impact_evidence: Description gives concrete commute, grocery, park, school, and healthcare query examples.
Visible map results make the output legible to users.
creativity_rationale: The combination of conversational multi-criteria spatial reasoning, human-drawn boundaries, trade-off explanations, and reversible shared state is a strong original synthesis.
creativity_evidence: Agent can pause for a map-drawn boundary and continue structured reasoning.
User and agent actions are recorded and reversible.
usability_note: Map-plus-sidebar interaction is familiar, though many simultaneous constraints can be cognitively demanding.
red_flags: Tool calls are not directly readable; some contact-sheet states may be debug or intermediate views.
standouts: Excellent fit for structured agent/map collaboration.
High practical impact with clear query examples.
advance_reason: Strong impact and leverage with a coherent, visibly demonstrated spatial workflow.

one_line: An electronics store whose live catalog schema becomes the agent’s filter vocabulary and preserves human vetoes.
what_it_does: Generates search schema from real inventory, ranks products, explains satisfied and missed constraints, and prevents vetoed items from returning.
leverage_rationale: The agent receives the store’s actual live vocabulary and constraints as structured schema, while veto state is enforced across later calls; this materially improves precision over UI driving.
leverage_evidence: Description says JSON Schema is generated from the real catalog and tool/UI share one rank function.
Frames show catalog, tool-console/schema, ranked results, and shortlist states.
execution_rationale: The compact product has a particularly clear invariant: the same ranking function backs UI and tools, and vetoed products cannot be re-added.
execution_evidence: Three frame sheets visibly show catalog/filter, tool/schema, and result/shortlist states.
Description gives a seeded fifteen-product catalog, deliberate trap/near-miss, and unconditional veto enforcement.
impact_rationale: Shoppers making technical purchases benefit from translating needs into specs, seeing trade-offs, and avoiding previously rejected products.
impact_evidence: Description identifies the gap between plain-language needs and electronics-store vocabulary.
Frames show ranked results with explanation-oriented product UI.
creativity_rationale: Treating the store’s own live filter vocabulary as an agent schema and making human vetoes durable is an original, disciplined interaction design.
creativity_evidence: Schema generated from real inventory rather than a generic agent prompt.
Veto boundary is explicitly hardened against agent re-add attempts.
usability_note: Explained near-misses and one-click vetoes make a complex product-selection task understandable.
red_flags: Small seeded catalog limits evidence of broader catalog robustness.
advance_reason: Highly complete and well-evidenced agent-native commerce workflow.

one_line: A wiki where humans request changes and agents maintain the source of truth with evidence, revisions, and auditability.
what_it_does: Creates a scoped handoff from the active wiki page, lets agents read and update live state, and applies reviewed changes into linked, versioned documents rather than a chat transcript.
leverage_rationale: Page-scoped tools carry active wiki, role, revision, evidence graph, and operational state, enabling safe agent maintenance that generic UI automation cannot reliably reproduce.
leverage_evidence: Description explicitly argues for live page-scoped state, stable IDs, current revisions, evidence graphs, and audit trail.
Frames show wiki/document views, request/change states, and updated content surfaces.
execution_rationale: The product concept is unusually coherent across request, agent maintenance, source-of-truth update, evidence, revisions, and audit views; exact end-to-end application is not fully legible.
execution_evidence: Three frame sheets show wiki reading/edit-request and document/explore states.
Description specifies request handoff fields, linked sources, claim-level evidence, immutable revisions, and audit trail.
impact_rationale: Small research, product, policy, and engineering teams have a real recurring burden keeping knowledge current, sourced, linked, and conflict-free.
impact_evidence: Description identifies wiki staleness and document-chatbot limitations.
Visible product surfaces are centered on durable wiki content rather than ephemeral answers.
creativity_rationale: Reframing wiki maintenance as scoped human intent plus agent stewardship, with results living in the wiki, is a deep and memorable interaction model.
creativity_evidence: Human-facing workspace emphasizes reading/judgment rather than direct editing.
Handoff includes exact target, version, scope, and authorization instead of copying page content into a second database.
usability_note: Request-change flow should reduce editing burden, though role/revision/evidence concepts add complexity.
red_flags: Login/role and full applied-change flow are described more clearly than they are legible in the contact sheets.
standouts: Strongest case for page-scoped WebMCP state.
advance_reason: Transformative leverage, high impact, and unusually coherent source-of-truth design.
